paragraphs: Hyman cites Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 14, where Rabbi Shimon bar Meisha asks Rabbi Elazar a question.

notes.text: The supplied locator reads ה״יר. The former draft interpreted it as halakhah 10, but that reading is unconfirmed. A matching question by Shimon bar Meisha before Rabbi Elazar occurs in the saved Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:12. The literal locator is retained; its numbering remains unresolved.

Hyman’s printed page (vol. III, p. 1203) reads ה״יד, halakhah 14. The supplied transcription has ה״יר. In Guggenheimer’s numbering, the exchange appears at 1:12. Rabbi Shimon asks Rabbi Elazar what must be visible for the rule about eating sacrifices at Shiloh.
